blocking: Repeated ruled columns and bordered sections conflict with the no-grid-hairlines direction.

fixes.why: The repeated rules make the editorial brand feel like a structured worksheet.

fixes.what: Use asymmetric mobile padding: 56px beside the left trunk and 24px on the open right side.
fixes.why: Recovers reading space while keeping artwork clear of text and inputs.

fixes.why: The arch currently dominates the phone screen while the brand and service description are pushed into the lower third.

fixes.what: Narrow the cream feathering to the artwork's inner boundary and ground transition; preserve more of the painted bark and root contours.
fixes.why: The broad pale halos make the illustration look airbrushed onto the page rather than integrated with the parchment.
